AI coding assistants can accelerate your data science learning, provided you use them safely and in line with University policy.

## University AI Policy

The [Academic Integrity and Assistance Policy](https://secretariat.leeds.ac.uk/home/academic-regulations-and-taught-student-policies-and-procedures/academic-integrity-and-assistance-policy/) permits the supportive use of digital technologies and generative AI unless restricted by a specific assessment brief.

- **Check assessment briefs:** Restrictions vary by module and assessment.
- **Acknowledge use:** Declare which tools you used and how they contributed.
- **Take responsibility:** You must understand, verify, and be able to explain all submitted code and analysis.

## 1. Enterprise Route (Recommended for University Data)

**Microsoft 365 Copilot** is the University-recommended tool for minimising data protection risks.

- **Privacy:** Logging in with your `@leeds.ac.uk` account at [m365.cloud.microsoft/chat](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat) ensures prompts are not used to train external models.
- **Usage:** Draft text, summarise documents, or explain code concepts.

## 2. Developer & Agentic Tools (For Coding)

**GitHub Copilot** and agentic coding assistants integrate directly into IDEs such as VS Code and RStudio.

- **Data protection:** External tools do not have University enterprise data protection. **Never** input personal, sensitive, or unpublished research data.
- **Code provenance:** AI tools may reproduce open-source code (e.g., from GitHub) without attribution; always verify accuracy and licensing.
- **Access:** Students can get free access to GitHub Copilot via the [GitHub Student Developer Pack](https://education.github.com/pack) using their `.ac.uk` email.

## Best Practices

::: callout-tip
### Effective Workflows

- Write clear comments and break complex tasks into small, testable steps
- Use AI to explain error messages and unfamiliar code
- Review, run, and verify all generated code before committing
- Keep notes or example prompts to document how you used AI
:::
